name: query_depmap
description: Get cancer cell line dependency scores for a gene from DepMap (requires data lake volume mounted)
usage: from app.tools.biomni.data_lake import query_depmap; result = query_depmap('KRAS', top_k=20)

parameters.top_k: int — number of most dependent cell lines to return (default 20)

returns: dict with keys: gene, mean_dependency_score, n_cell_lines, most_dependent_lines (dict of cell_line: score), source
